users.title: Accounts & sessions
users.description: Super Admin & developer accounts, who is online right now, and emergency sign-out.
users.onlineDesc: Anyone active in the last 20 minutes.
users.superadminsDesc: Highest authority above Developers. Only a Super Admin can manage Super Admin accounts.
users.addSuperadminDesc: New e-mail → creates the account. Existing e-mail → promotes that account to Super Admin.
users.developersDesc: Developers can do everything owners can, plus this panel. Owners can't change developer accounts.
users.addDeveloperDesc: New e-mail → creates the account. Existing e-mail → that account becomes a developer.
users.signOutDesc: Ends sessions on every device. Your own session stays signed in.

form.removeConfirmSuper: Remove Super Admin access from {name}? The account stays as a developer.

site.title: Maintenance & site
site.description: Switch the site into maintenance, show a banner to everyone, or pause new sign-ups. Changes are live on the next page load.
site.maintenanceDesc: Visitors and students see a maintenance screen. Staff (admins, owners, developers, super admins) keep full access, and the sign-in page stays open.
site.announcementDesc: A banner at the top of the student and admin pages. People can close it; a new message shows again.
site.signupsDesc: Close sign-ups to pause new registrations. Existing students can still sign in.

logs.title: Activity log
logs.description: Everything staff and developers changed, slips, orders, roles, settings, newest first.
logs.searchPlaceholder: Search name, Student ID, summary, bank ref…

tools.title: Tools & exports
tools.description: Download data as CSV (opens in Excel / Google Sheets) and maintenance helpers.
tools.csvDesc: Every export is recorded in the activity log.
tools.cacheDesc: Pages are rebuilt automatically after changes. Clear the cache if something still looks out of date.

results.title: Results & teacher photos
results.description: Manage the public results page and rotating photos in the About the teacher section.
results.teacherPhotosDesc: Upload multiple portraits. A different photo appears on each refresh in the same browser tab. If there are none, the Brand & SEO teacher photo is used.
results.addResultDesc: Add a distinction for a prominent featured result; leave it blank for a regular result. New results start unpublished.
results.manageResultsDesc: Edit, publish, unpublish or delete results. Photo uploads are optional.

theme.title: Theme & colours
theme.description: Pick a brand colour, button style, corner roundness, and light/dark mode for the whole site.
theme.brandColourDesc: Choose a preset or any colour.
theme.buttonsDesc: How filled buttons use the colour.
theme.readabilityDesc: Contrast ratios, 4.5 or more is easy to read.

content.title: Site text
content.description: Change any sentence, button or heading on the site, in English or Sinhala. Keep {words in curly brackets}: the site fills them in. Changes are live on the next page load.
